_comment: PLC (AutomationDirect Productivity, Modbus TCP). ALL REGISTER NUMBERS BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS until the real register map exists. Registers are 0-based holding-register offsets (Modbus 400001 = 0), 16-bit each. Protocol: docs/PLC-PROTOCOL.md. Set Enabled to true to use the PLC instead of the keyboard/console stand-ins.

Plc._ButtonCodes: Button id (buttons.json) -> the code the PLC writes into an event slot. Placeholder: code = button id.
Plc._LedRegisters: Button id -> holding register for its LED. Values written: 0 off, 1 on, 2 blink. Placeholder: 200 + (button id - 10).
Plc._LightingCueRegisters: Room id -> holding register for its lighting scene. Values: 0 Idle, 1 Intro, 2 Question, 3 Reveal, 4 Standings, 5 Results.
